This is an isolated, disposable code exercise. Fix only task.py so unique_in_order
returns first occurrences in input order, supports unhashable values and iterators,
and leaves its input unchanged. Run python oracle.py and report the result.
Preserve oracle.py and all other files exactly. Do not delegate, access the network,
publish, create a branch/worktree, or modify anything outside this exercise directory.
The exercise ends when this one behavior is correct and its check has passed.
